dftbplus/scalapackfx.manifest:
name = "scalapackfx"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "BSD-2-Clause"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
[build]
link = ["scalapack-mpich", "mpichfort", "mpich", "openblas"]
external-modules = ["mpi", "mpi_f08"]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true
[fortran]
implicit-typing = true
implicit-external = true
source-form = "default"

scope: The upstream CMake library source list is generated with Fypp 3.2 and exact generated-output checksums. The example uses a 1-by-1 BLACS grid and pinned MPICH, ScaLAPACK and OpenBLAS native libraries. It computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a symmetric 3-by-3 tridiagonal matrix using scalafx_psyev, checks eigenvalues against 2-sqrt(2), 2 and 2+sqrt(2), and independently checks eigenpair residuals and orthogonality. All entries must be finite. D4a1 (ordinary real symmetric eigenproblems) applies to the tested eigensolver. This is a one-process API example, not a distributed-performance demonstration; other solvers, generalized eigenproblems and multiple processes are not verified.
generation_note: Fypp 3.2 output checksums were independently reproduced on Linux/Python 3.12 from the pinned templates. LF text normalization keeps hashes identical on Windows and Linux.
runtime_note: The checked example uses one MPI process. UCX emits a network-discovery diagnostic about /sys/class/net, which the restricted gVisor sandbox does not expose. The program exits successfully and all data/numerical checks pass. The diagnostic is retained verbatim in verified-output.txt.
initial_consumer_findings: The initial example omitted a definition of dp. The corrected main explicitly imports real64 from iso_fortran_env; no upstream library change was required.
